disclosures: Warp speed skew (A6.4): the warp prior U(0.7, 1.3) is symmetric (drawn mean 1.0149), but the accepted warps skew slow: mean speed 0.8879 (6 faster, 33 slower of 39); of 35 rejected, 35 are speed-ups (mean 1.1564). This is a structural consequence of export_warps' speed rule (|dq| <= max(p99, the window's own fastest) + 0.05 rad/s): a strike sped up by s passes only where the clip set's p99 is above s x its own fastest joint speed, so the accepted set is slow-biased although the prior is not.
Mirror conjugation (A6.2): rows with mirror = 1 are performed by the mirror-conjugated tracker (gpu/fb_mirror.py); the T1 motion holds them un-mirrored and leaves out the mirror family.

Combos (A6.1): the stated speed rule (allowance max(p99, the host window's own fastest, the source segment's own fastest) + 0.05 rad/s, the join never counted) with the shortest passing fade in the prior range [0.15, 0.35] s; 1 of 4 tried splices survive.
vmax (p99 joint speed) is computed per clip set (A6.3): kfab_200/201 (LOCO).
